title: Automatic 125 cc scooter
reference: Modern 125 cc twist-and-go scooter of the Honda PCX / Yamaha NMAX / Vespa Primavera family (generic, unbranded)
wheels: 14 in front / 13 in rear cast alloy (gunmetal), 110/70-14 and 130/70-13 road tyres
engine: 125 cc liquid-cooled SOHC single, near-horizontal cylinder, unit-swing with CVT belt drive (case on left) and final reduction gearbox at the rear axle; radiator with louvred cover on the right
colours: Satin grey-blue body panels, black lower panels, floorboard and leg shield; gunmetal wheels; cast-aluminium CVT case
weak_points: The CVT cover is a smooth convex hull with a flat brushed panel and lacks the cast ribbing and stepped profile of the real part; the headlight and front shield styling is generic; the seat is a single loft with no stitching; the inner leg shield and glovebox lids are only visible from the rear 3/4 view; the tyres use plain road grooves with no sipes.
